classification: exact synthetic forward-spectrum; method mapping only
limitations: does not use raw Wilson measurements or estimate physical q bounds
does not establish positive transfer-matrix assumptions for production data
does not fit energies/overlaps, calibrate interval coverage, or quantify finite-Nt effects
td=2 GEVP composite is a separate diagnostic and must not populate kernel-indexed q cells
independent review and authorized raw cross-correlator measurements remain required

selected_q_overlap_contract.fit_source: joint finite-Nt spectral fit to the measured 3x3 C_ij(R,t) matrix
selected_q_overlap_contract.gevp_role: GEVP may initialize, label, and stress-test joint spectral fits; its single composite projected operator is separate and must not be copied into identity, APE, or stout kernel-indexed q cells
selected_q_overlap_contract.operator_overlap_convention: Z_nk(R)=<n|O_k(R)|0> for the ordered bare smearing operator O_k
selected_q_overlap_contract.scope: positive forward-spectrum q term only; finite-Nt backward/thermal, mixed-sector, fit-truncation, and interval-coverage bounds remain separate
